dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 04, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Philly Takes Down Padres in Thrilling 6-4 Win"

In a high-scoring affair, the Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the San Diego Padres 6-4, led by a strong performance from Zack Wheeler, who tossed seven innings, striking out eight and allowing just two earned runs. Jackson Merrill hit a crucial two-run homer for the Padres, but it wasn't enough to overcome Wheeler's dominant outing. Meanwhile, Bryce Johnson and Alec Bohm also had big days at the plate for the Phillies, driving in crucial runs.

In other action, the Baltimore Orioles defeated the Boston Red Sox 8-2 behind a strong team effort on the mound. Willson Contreras hit a solo homer for the Orioles, his 12th of the season, while Trevor Rogers earned the win with five strong innings of work.
